description: Two XML weaknesses that live on the same call and are not the same thing. huge_tree lifts the guard against a small document expanding into a large one; the default parser resolves external entities. Supplying a parser at all is how the second gets fixed, so the rule for it says nothing where one was supplied -- a rule that reports its own remedy is worse than one that stays quiet.

expected.note: the guard against a small document expanding into a large one, removed by name
no parser supplied, so lxml's default is used and that one resolves entities
